profile.name: Dr. Babu George
profile.title: Professor of Business
profile.bio: Babu George is a business scholar and academic leader at Alcorn State University. His work examines how people and institutions respond to technological change, make strategic decisions, and navigate questions of responsibility and inclusion. His research brings behavioral, economic, sociological, and philosophical perspectives to higher education, business, and community life.
